# netactuate_vpc_ssh (Data Source)

Reads a VPC SSH.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_ssh" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID.

### Read-Only

- `bastion_ipv4` (String) Bastion IPv4 address.
- `bastion_ipv6` (String) Bastion IPv6 address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VPC bastion service is enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number) Bastion SSH port, or 0 when absent.
